meta.title: ShortlistBuddy — AI Travel Photo Curation
meta.description: Turn 1,000 vacation photos into 50 perfect memories. AI-powered selection, configurable criteria, instant download.

guides.indexLead: Practical guides on choosing, organising and printing your holiday photos.
guides.ctaText: Let ShortlistBuddy do the first pass — turn your holiday photos into a reviewable shortlist in minutes.

hero.title: 1,000 travel photos.
hero.subtitle: AI analyses your vacation photos and picks the best ones. You review, adjust, and download — or send them straight to a photobook.
hero.demoNote: Demo mode — no account needed, runs on your device

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Drop your photos here or connect your Dropbox (more cloud providers are planned). We only read reduced previews — your high-resolution originals are not sent to our AI.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI rates composition, faces, landscapes, animals, duplicates and more, and proposes a selection. How long that takes depends on how many photos there are. Add your own criteria (e.g. “dog”) once, before the analysis; afterwards just move the sliders to rebalance.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Based on your criteria and target count, the AI proposes a selection. Confirm the photos, re-select with different criteria, or add/remove individual shots — as long and as often as you like, until your preferred set is ready. The chosen photos are sorted by date and location.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Download your selection as a ZIP to keep it locally or in the cloud. You can also use that set directly to create a photo book.

showcase.title: From a thousand shots to your best few
showcase.subtitle: ShortlistBuddy highlights the keepers and quietly sets the rest aside — you stay in control.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.subtitle: Free during the beta. The planned prices are below — they are not bookable yet.

upload.title: Upload your travel photos
upload.dropzone: Drag & drop photos here, or click to browse
upload.supported: Supports JPEG, PNG, HEIC. Up to {limit} photos.
upload.keepFilesNote: Please leave your photos where they are until the download is finished. If they are moved, renamed, deleted or edited in the meantime, your browser can no longer read them — those photos then end up in the ZIP as small previews only.
upload.tooMany: You selected {count} photos, which exceeds the {limit} limit for the {tier} tier.
upload.someFailed: {count} photo(s) couldn't be processed and won't be included.
upload.dbxAllFailed: Couldn't download from Dropbox ({reason}). Please retry.
upload.dbxSomeFailed: {count} of {total} downloads failed — importing the rest.

criteria.title: Configure selection criteria
criteria.subtitle: Toggle criteria on/off and adjust their importance. The AI will prioritise accordingly.
criteria.facesDesc: Prefer photos with open eyes and friendly expressions
criteria.landscapesDesc: Include scenic views typical of the region
criteria.foodDesc: Include the best food and restaurant shots
criteria.diversityDesc: Ensure a balanced mix of different scene types
criteria.selectionPercentageDesc: AI will choose between 1 and up to 30% of all photos.
criteria.sliderLegend: No slider: balanced · 1–9: more of that subject · 10: only that subject
criteria.modeOnly: Only: {motifs} — every matching photo (series are collapsed).
criteria.customDesc: Your own terms (e.g. “car”, “dog”). Exclusions work too — for example “no snow”. Up to 7.
criteria.customSetupHint: Set every term you want before the first “Analyze” — they're locked for this run afterwards.
criteria.customLockedNote: Custom criteria are locked once the analysis has run. Start a new job for a different set.
criteria.customFilterActive: Exclusion filter active — photos containing this are always removed, regardless of other criteria.
criteria.personsDesc: Upload reference photos and name people — the AI then filters for photos where they are recognised.
criteria.personsConsent: Note: reference photos are sent to our LLM provider for face matching and held only for this session. They are not stored beyond the session. Please only upload photos of people who have consented.
criteria.personsProcessFailed: Could not process this photo. Please try a different image.
criteria.personsAddFailed: Could not add person. Check name and count.
criteria.personsSetupHint: Up to {max} persons — set before the first “Analyse”.
criteria.personsLockedNote: Persons are locked once the analysis has run. Start a new job to change them.
criteria.personFilterActive: Exclusion filter active — photos with {name} are always removed, regardless of other criteria.
criteria.aiNotice: Note: ShortlistBuddy uses artificial intelligence to create a non-binding selection proposal. Reduced previews are sent to Google Gemini for analysis, together with the capture date, camera model and — where the photo contains one — the location as a GPS coordinate rounded to about one kilometre, from which the AI derives the place name. Google may retain transmitted data and outputs for abuse monitoring for up to 55 days. Please review the result and keep your originals separately.
criteria.tooManyForAnyTier: More than {max} photos cannot be processed in one run yet. Drop us a line at {email} — at these volumes we will find a way.
criteria.analysisPartial: {done} of {total} photos were analysed. The rest could not be processed: {error} You'll see the analysed ones now — the others can follow later.
criteria.budgetExceeded: You can analyse about {remaining} more photos today, but {requested} are selected. Reduce the selection or try again tomorrow.
criteria.ageConfirm18: I am at least 18 years old.
criteria.termsConfirm: I accept the Terms of Use.
criteria.personsConfirm: I confirm that I use all reference photos solely for private purposes among family or friends and that the required explicit agreement is in place for every person shown for temporary AI-assisted recognition and the transfer of reduced images to Google.
criteria.confirmRequired: Please tick the age confirmation (and the reference-photo confirmation, if applicable) to continue.
criteria.dedupDesc: How aggressively to remove similar photos
criteria.noPhotosConfigure: No photos in memory. Please upload photos first.

review.title: Review your selection
review.subtitle: {selected} of {total} photos selected
review.noPhotos: No photos to review. Upload photos first.

results.subtitle: {count} photos selected from {total}

results.fullResNote: {count} full-resolution photos as a ZIP archive

results.sourceIssuesHint: This happens when photos are moved, renamed, deleted or edited in their folder while a session is running. Put them back and start the download again to get full resolution.
results.sourceAllGone: None of the selected photos could be read from your folder. They were probably moved, renamed or deleted after the upload. Restore them and try again.
results.cloudHint: Copies your selection into a ShortlistBuddy Auswahl folder in your cloud.

auth.gdprConsent: I agree to the {terms} and {privacy}. My photos will be processed by AI for curation purposes. I can delete my data at any time.
auth.checkEmailDesc: If there is no account for {email} yet, a confirmation email is on its way — click the link in it to activate your account. If an account already exists for this address, we do not send an email: just log in instead.
auth.confirmedBanner: Your email is confirmed — please log in.
auth.confirmErrorBanner: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Please log in, or sign up again.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email address. We'll send you a link that lets you set a new password.
auth.resetSentDesc: If there is an account for {email}, a link to set a new password is on its way. If there isn't, we send nothing — you can sign up instead. The link is valid for a short time only and works in this browser only, so it's best to open it here right away.
auth.resetMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.resetInvalidDesc: It has expired, has already been used, or you opened it in a different browser from the one you requested it in. Just request a new one and open it in this browser.
auth.passwordResetBanner: Your password has been changed — log in with the new one.

withdrawal.title: Withdraw from contract
withdrawal.intro: Here you can withdraw from your ShortlistBuddy contract — the paid one as well as the free one. Fill in the fields and confirm the withdrawal. We record the time of receipt and send you a confirmation by email straight away.
withdrawal.alternative: You can also declare your withdrawal informally by letter or email. Details and the model withdrawal form are in the
withdrawal.fieldContractHint: The order number from your order confirmation. If you do not have it to hand, the date and plan will do — for the free plan, the date of the analysis.
withdrawal.fieldEmailHint: We will send the receipt, with date and time, to this address.
withdrawal.fieldNoteHint: If you have several contracts: which part you wish to withdraw from.
withdrawal.doneReceipt: A receipt with the content, date and time is on its way to {email}. Please keep it as your record.
withdrawal.doneNotAssessed: This confirmation concerns receipt only. We will review the matter and be in touch.

withdrawal.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later — or send us your withdrawal by email to contact@shortlistbuddy.com.
